title: Report: GTA 6 Car Service walkthrough: how to steal the Schafter V12
description: Video Games Chronicle has published a full GTA 6 Chapter 3 walkthrough for the Car Service mission, in which Lucia steals a Benefactor Schafter V12 from a gang-run chop shop in Vice City and delivers it to one of Raul's contacts. The guide also introduces Randy, a new vehicle drop-off point.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Car Service: Steal the Schafter V12 from the Chop Shop
socialHook: VGC's GTA 6 Car Service guide shows how Lucia steals the Benefactor Schafter V12 from a Vice City chop shop.

sections.heading: Mission unlock and objective (spoilers ahead)
paragraphs: According to Video Games Chronicle, Car Service is a GTA 6 Chapter 3 mission that becomes available after completing Meet the Heders. Players should wait roughly one in-game day for a message from Raul, which places a new mission marker in Vice City directing Lucia to steal a Benefactor Schafter V12 from a gang hideout and deliver it to one of Raul's contacts. VGC notes the mission also introduces Randy, described as a new vehicle drop-off point.

sections.heading: Gearing up and approaching the chop shop
paragraphs: VGC's walkthrough advises looking for a nearby vehicle with equipment stored in its trunk before entering the compound, which contains a silenced Klose K17 pistol and flash grenades. The silenced pistol is recommended because the chop shop is open plan and difficult to move through stealthily. To reach the roof, head toward a white van and climb onto it to access the metal roofing surrounding the yard, where you can survey the gang members guarding the entrance. VGC warns that attacking the dog near the gates unnecessarily can negatively affect your criminal profile.

sections.heading: Grabbing the car and escaping
paragraphs: The Schafter V12 is parked underneath the covered section in the middle of the chop shop, next to a small room, and VGC says you can scan it with the WAINK app to verify it is the correct vehicle. You do not have to take out the guards and can simply leave with the car, but VGC reports that eliminating them is easier and avoids risking damage to the car, which will fail the mission. The exact reward payout is not stated in the material supplied by the publisher, and players should check the full VGC guide for any further detail.
